title: Embedded report chart leaves room for the report table after arriving from the Dashboard and after a window resize
custom_preconds:
Signed in as owner/admin with the Reports permission.
Browser storage holds no report_visualization_open_techEfficiencySeries key, so the report chart opens on its default (shown).
Browser window 1536x730.
No report data needs to be seeded: the chart box is the same size whether it shows data or "No data for selected date range".

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the Dashboard and wait for its tiles to load.
Use the Reports navigation to open Technician Efficiency, without reloading the page.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The report loads with the chart shown above the table, and the chart has finished loading (a drawn chart or "No data for selected date range").
The chart card is no taller than the chart itself (well under 300px at this window height), with no large empty white area below the chart.

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at the report table under the chart.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The table has at least 160px of visible body on screen, not just its header or Totals row.
The chart grows taller, up to its 345px maximum.
The chart shrinks back to the height it had in step 3, and the table again has at least 160px of visible body.
